newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - March 27.
newsitem.headline: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - March 27.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:
Comex Gold price jumps US$3.00 to US$353.50 on startling revelations by Freeport McMoran that Busang tests show insignificant amounts of gold at the Indonesian prospect.

PNG-linked stocks started rallying very late in Wednesday trade just after Prime Minister Sir Julius Chan told parliament he would stand aside, meeting the key demand of protestors and rebellious soldiers and appearing to end 10 days of turmoil.

News Corp's loss-making Asian satellite broadcaster STAR TV plans to invest hundreds of millions of dollars in India's first direct-to-home (DTH) satellite pay channel, company officials said late on Wednesday. Also late on Wednesday, USA Today reported that News Corp was seeking to pay about US$600 million for about 40 percent of International Family Entertainment Inc and air shows from his Fox Kids service on that company's Family Channel.
National Mutual Holdings Ltd on Wednesday won a licence to operate in Thailand, meeting a key Asian objective and leaving the group focused on its top priority, China.
Troubled casino operator Reef Casino Trust said on Wednesday that chairman John Coates had resigned in order to devote more time to his role as president of the Australian Olympic Committee (AOC).
